definitions.explanation: Refers to both parents together. This is a neutral term that can be used when talking about one's own parents or someone else's parents.

examples.japanese: {両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}しました→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}しています→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
{両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your parents.
examples.notes: ご両親 is the honorific form

notes:
{両親|りょうしん} means parents - referring to both mother and father together.

FORMS:
⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ (both) + {親|しん} (parent) = both parents

REGISTER:
- {両親|りょうしん}: standard/formal
- ご{両親|りょうしん}: honorific (for others' parents)
- ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧: my father and mother (casual)
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: dad and mom (casual)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧: to be grateful to one's parents
- {両親|りょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: to support one's parents
- {両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧: to meet one's parents
- ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧: give my regards to your parents

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧: father
- ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧: mother
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: parent(s)
- ⟦{片親|かたおや}→片親：27516_kataoya⟧: single parent
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両親|りょうしん}: in-laws

USAGE:
When talking about your own parents to others, use {両親|りょうしん}, ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧, ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧. When asking about or referring to someone else's parents, use ご{両親|りょうしん}, ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧, ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧.
